themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 6 champion buffs, 4 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: We’re kicking off Season 3…but of what year?! Structured changes across 17 entities this patch.

champions.name: Alistar
champions.tldr: Base movement speed increased to 335 from 330.
champions.gameplayImpact: Alistar is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Base movement speed
lines.note: Base movement speed increased to 335 from 330.

champions.name: Bel'Veth
champions.tldr: Total attack animation adjusted to feel better at lower attack speeds.; Model size reduced to 95% from 100%.
champions.gameplayImpact: Bel'Veth was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.note: Total attack animation adjusted to feel better at lower attack speeds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New: Bel'Veth's ability casts grant her ghosting and 20% bonus attack speed for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Old: Bel'Veth's ability casts each generate 2 stacks of Death in Lavender, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and subsequent casts, and stacking up to 6 times. While Bel'Veth has stacks, she becomes ghosted and gains 20+(20/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))% bonus attack speed. Her basic attacks each consume 1 stack.

lines.label: Lavender bonus attack speed per stack
lines.note: Lavender bonus attack speed per stack changed to 0.1–2% from 0.28–1.1%.

lines.label: Base dash speed

lines.label: Cooldown
lines.note: Cooldown increased to 4–1 seconds from 1 at all ranks.

champions.name: Neeko
champions.tldr: New Effect: When disguising as a Voidborn Rift Scuttler, Neeko now adopts the Rift Scuttler's Voidborn model instead of its base model.; New Effect: When disguising as Nidalee in Aspect of the Cougar or Elise in Spide…
champions.gameplayImpact: Neeko is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: When disguising as a Voidborn Rift Scuttler, Neeko now adopts the Rift Scuttler's Voidborn model instead of its base model.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: When disguising as Lulu, the spawned Pix, Faerie Companion now uses a skin based on Lulu's skin ID instead of Neeko's skin ID.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: When disguising as Nidalee in Aspect of the Cougar or Elise in Spider Form, Neeko now adopts their current models instead of their base models, and becomes melee with 125 range.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: Neeko's movement speed is no longer reduced by 25 when disguising as Elise.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that prevented her to disguise herself as DJ Sona Concussive and Ethereal Forms.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where if she was disguised as DJ Sona Kinetic form the hair was missing.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: When disguising as Smolder, Neeko's horns will now reflect Smolder's current number of Dragon Practice stacks.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: While disguised as Bel'Veth, Neeko's attacks now deal the intended amount of damage instead of 0.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: Disrupting Neeko's leap no longer enables her to store stats across units.
